test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A person starts from point Z and moves 7 km towards the South. He turns right and moves 5 km, turns right, and moves 3 km, then turns right and moves 1 km. He takes a left turn and moves 4 km to reach a point X. How much and in which direction does he need to move now to reach point Z?
solution: According to the given information, 1) A person starts from point Z and moves 7 km towards the South. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7068c4077157a676e5c6fcf764d0b267a7fe4255d89a3030336baf7431a5ef9f.png] 2) He turns right and moves 5 km, turns right, and moves 3 km, then turns right and moves 1 km.
